pid_file.description: PID file (unset keeps the shipped commented line; systemd tracks the process anyway).

persistence.description: Save in-memory messages and subscriptions to disk.

persistence_location.description: Directory of the persistence database (trailing slash).

listeners.description: Extra listeners: port and optional bind_address. Mosquitto 2 without one listens on localhost:1883 only.

allow_anonymous.description: Allow clients without a username (mosquitto 2 default: false once a listener is defined).
